description: This is a Markdown source file documenting the 'BrowserContext' class in Playwright API, including its properties, events, methods, parameters, and usage examples.

classes.name: BrowserContext
classes.description: Provides an interface to operate multiple independent browser sessions, manage events, pages, routes, permissions, cookies, and other context-specific settings within Playwright.

methods.name: addCookies
methods.description: Adds cookies into this browser context which are accessible to all pages within this context.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds a script that will be evaluated in newly created pages and frames within the context before any scripts run.

methods.name: backgroundPages
methods.description: Returns an empty list as background pages are not supported or have been removed from Chromium-based browsers.

methods.name: browser
methods.description: Gets the browser instance that owns this context, or null if created outside of the browser.

methods.name: clearCookies
methods.description: Removes cookies from the context, with optional filters by name, domain, or path.

methods.name: clearPermissions
methods.description: Clears all permission overrides for the browser context.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser context and all associated pages.

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies associated with this context, optionally filtered by URLs.

methods.name: exposeBinding
methods.description: Exposes a function onto the `window` object of all pages and frames in the context that can be called from page scripts.

methods.name: exposeFunction
methods.description: Exposes a function onto the `window` object of all pages/frames, which can be invoked from page scripts.

methods.name: grantPermissions
methods.description: Grants specified permissions to the context for all pages within, optionally limited to a specific origin.

methods.name: newCDPSession
methods.description: Creates a new Chrome DevTools Protocol session for the context's pages (Chromium only).

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page within this browser context.

methods.name: pages
methods.description: Returns all open pages within this context.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all event listeners of a given type or all listeners if no type specified.

methods.name: route
methods.description: Sets up route handlers to intercept, modify, fulfill, or abort network requests matching a pattern.

methods.name: routeFromHAR
methods.description: Serves network requests from a HAR file, optionally updating or filtering requests based on patterns.

methods.name: routeWebSocket
methods.description: Routes WebSocket connections matching a pattern, enabling message interception and modification.

methods.name: serviceWorkers
methods.description: Returns all active service workers in the context ( Chromium only).

methods.name: setDefaultNavigationTimeout
methods.description: Overrides the default maximum navigation timeout for pages within the context.

methods.name: setDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Overrides the default maximum timeout for most Playwright operations within the context.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets extra HTTP headers to be sent with all requests from pages within this context.

methods.name: setGeolocation
methods.description: Overrides the geolocation info for pages in this context.

methods.name: setHTTPCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP credentials (deprecated) for authentication purposes.

methods.name: setOffline
methods.description: Emulates offline mode for all pages within this context.

methods.name: storageState
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the storage state (cookies, localStorage, IndexedDB) for this context.

methods.name: unroute
methods.description: Removes route handlers based on URL patterns or handlers.

methods.name: unrouteAll
methods.description: Removes all route handlers from this context.

methods.name: waitForCondition
methods.description: Blocks execution until a specified condition function returns true, dispatching events during the wait.

methods.name: waitForConsoleMessage
methods.description: Waits for a console message matching criteria, optionally filtered by predicate.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specified event on the context, optionally with a predicate filtering event data.

methods.name: waitForEvent2
methods.description: A variant of waitForEvent, with additional options or predicates.

methods.name: waitForPage
methods.description: Performs an action and waits for a new page to be created, optionally filtered by predicate.

methods.name: waitForPage
methods.description: Same as above, with different overloads and options.
